newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, seen range-bound.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, seen range-bound.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.51 percent on Monday as investors continued to keep a low profile amid a dearth of trading incentives, traders said.

"Everybody is waiting for fresh foreign capital which is expected to come in May and push prices up. Until then shares will oscillate. This week the index may go up or down by a maximum of five percent," one said.
* The blue-chip SBI index fell 6.92 points to 1,343.86.
* Drug company Lek's A issue was the most active share, ending 0.4 percent lower at 25,270 tolars on 320 shares. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
